canDos.text: Greet your partner when they come home and ask about their day in casual Japanese.
Follow your partner's directions to find things around the house (on the table, in the fridge, under the sofa).
Say what you'll do this evening in order, linking the actions with the て-form.
Read a casual note from your partner saying where they've gone, where things are and what to do.
Send your partner a short casual message about your day: where you went and how it was.

task.goal: Find three things your partner left at home: the one who is out explains by phone where they should be, and the one at home searches the room and reports back.

roles.a: Out of the house; remembers roughly where they left things (card A)
roles.b: At home, with a picture of the room (card B)

capstone.title: An evening at home
capstone.brief: Act out an ordinary evening in casual Japanese: one of you comes home, you ask about each other's day, hunt for something that's gone missing, and plan the rest of the evening in order (dinner, bath, TV…).
